name: Shift Cashing Report
query:
WITH p AS (
    SELECT name, mode_of_payment, paid_amount, creation
    FROM `tabPayment Entry`
    WHERE docstatus = 1
      AND owner = %(agent)s
      AND creation BETWEEN %(shift_start)s AND %(shift_end)s
),

m AS (
    SELECT
        mop.name AS label,
        CASE mop.name
            WHEN 'Airtel 2'        THEN %(cash_airtel2)s
            WHEN 'Airtel 3'        THEN %(cash_airtel3)s
            WHEN 'Cash'            THEN %(cash_cash)s
            WHEN 'Okavango Airtel' THEN %(cash_okv_airtel)s
            WHEN 'Okavango MTN'    THEN %(cash_okv_mtn)s
            WHEN 'Spenn'           THEN %(cash_spenn)s
            WHEN 'Stanbic Wallet'  THEN %(cash_stanbic_wallet)s
            WHEN 'Tenga'           THEN %(cash_tenga)s
            WHEN 'Tingg'           THEN %(cash_tingg)s
            WHEN 'Merchant Airtel' THEN %(cash_merchant_airtel)s
            WHEN 'Swipe ABSA'      THEN %(cash_swipe_absa)s
            WHEN 'FNB Wallet'      THEN %(cash_fnb_wallet)s
            WHEN 'IZWE Pay'        THEN %(cash_izwe_pay)s
            ELSE 0
        END                                AS cashing,
        IFNULL(SUM(p.paid_amount),0)       AS system_balance,
        CASE mop.name
            WHEN 'Airtel 2'        THEN %(cash_airtel2)s
            WHEN 'Airtel 3'        THEN %(cash_airtel3)s
            WHEN 'Cash'            THEN %(cash_cash)s
            WHEN 'Okavango Airtel' THEN %(cash_okv_airtel)s
            WHEN 'Okavango MTN'    THEN %(cash_okv_mtn)s
            WHEN 'Spenn'           THEN %(cash_spenn)s
            WHEN 'Stanbic Wallet'  THEN %(cash_stanbic_wallet)s
            WHEN 'Tenga'           THEN %(cash_tenga)s
            WHEN 'Tingg'           THEN %(cash_tingg)s
            WHEN 'Merchant Airtel' THEN %(cash_merchant_airtel)s
            WHEN 'Swipe ABSA'      THEN %(cash_swipe_absa)s
            WHEN 'FNB Wallet'      THEN %(cash_fnb_wallet)s
            WHEN 'IZWE Pay'        THEN %(cash_izwe_pay)s
            ELSE 0
        END - IFNULL(SUM(p.paid_amount),0) AS variance,
        '' AS comment,
        1  AS sort_key
    FROM `tabMode of Payment` mop
    LEFT JOIN p ON p.mode_of_payment = mop.name
    WHERE mop.enabled = 1
    GROUP BY mop.name
),

past AS (
    SELECT 'Payments for Past Invoices','',IFNULL(SUM(p.paid_amount),0),'','',2
    FROM p
    LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` pr ON pr.parent=p.name AND pr.reference_doctype='Sales Invoice'
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name=pr.reference_name
    WHERE si.posting_date < DATE(%(shift_start)s)
),
today AS (
    SELECT 'Payments for Today''s Invoices','',IFNULL(SUM(p.paid_amount),0),'','',3
    FROM p
    LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` pr ON pr.parent=p.name AND pr.reference_doctype='Sales Invoice'
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name=pr.reference_name
    WHERE si.posting_date BETWEEN DATE(%(shift_start)s) AND DATE(%(shift_end)s)
),
future AS (
    SELECT 'Payments for Future Invoices','',IFNULL(SUM(p.paid_amount),0),'','',4
    FROM p
    LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` pr ON pr.parent=p.name AND pr.reference_doctype='Sales Invoice'
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name=pr.reference_name
    WHERE si.posting_date > DATE(%(shift_end)s)
),
unalloc AS (
    SELECT 'Unallocated Payments','',IFNULL(SUM(p.paid_amount),0),'','',5
    FROM p
    LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` pr ON pr.parent=p.name AND pr.reference_doctype='Sales Invoice'
    WHERE pr.name IS NULL
),

unpaid AS (
    SELECT
        si.name, 0, si.grand_total, si.outstanding_amount,
        si.customer, 6
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
    WHERE si.docstatus = 1
      AND si.owner = %(agent)s
      AND si.creation BETWEEN %(shift_start)s AND %(shift_end)s
      AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
)

SELECT
    label          AS "Mode of Payment:Data:200",
    cashing        AS "Cashing (Manual):Currency:130",
    system_balance AS "System Balance (Auto):Currency:150",
    variance       AS "Variance:Currency:120",
    comment        AS "Comment:Data:180"
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM m
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM past
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM today
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM future
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM unalloc
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM unpaid
) x
ORDER BY sort_key, label
